asr.full_text: This video will guide it through the process of creating an account to start earning from staking BNB or NFC with Star Wallets Star Wallets is a revolutionary DeFi staking platform that pays you in real time now let me break down what you can expect from this platform earn a one percent daily profit the account matures in 45 days your investment capital will be fully returned after 45 days 100% fully decentralized platform in the referral system you will receive five percent of their deposit amount each time your invite makes a deposit before you proceed please ensure that you have installed the meta mass toilet or trust wallet on your mobile device if you are using a desktop computer you can also add a browser extension then set up your wallet for the security of your account be sure to keep your wallet's private keys in a safe place in this tutorial we will use the mobile version with the metamask wallet after setting up your wallet open your metamask wallet and select the bsc or binance smart chain network then fund your wallet with bnb click the browser icon below it's important to note that a referral link is required for signing up to gain access to exclusive benefits because you won't be able to sign up without a referral link to proceed copy the referral link from the person who referred you to star wallets and paste it into the search bar to signed up fill out the signed up form with your first name last name email address mobile, password and confirm your password then complete the capture. A pop-up message will indicate that you need to verify your email. Go to your email and find the activation message containing the activation link to activate your account. You will then redirect to the signup page. Enter your email address and password and click the sign in button or simply click the connect wallet button. For the purpose of this tutorial this account has an active BNB staking worth $100 with a $28 profit, earning $1 daily. This means that the account has been running for 28 days. There are several ways to earn from this platform. Aside from staking BNB or NSTs, you can also earn through referral bonuses, royalty bonuses, and pairing bonuses. That's why your account is provided with two different referral links, one for the left referral, and one for the left referral and one for the right referral as you can see on the screen. To access the BNB staking page, click the hamburger menu in the top right corner of your screen. Then scroll and find the BNB staking option and click it. To activate your staking, you will need a PIN. If you don't have a available PIN, simply click the CLICK TO BUY PIN button. Let's assume you want to purchase a hamburger or burger as you will need a PIN. If you don't have an available PIN, simply click the Click to Buy PIN button. Let's assume you want to purchase 2 pins. You will need to pay this amount of BNB to get the 2 pins. One pin is equivalent to 10$. Then click the purchase button. You also have the option to send or transfer a PIN in another account, you can find the project history below. Let's return to the staking page. The minimum staking amount is one hundred dollars, simply type in your preferred staking BNB value. Let's assume you want to stake one hundred dollars. If you already have an available bin, click stake, the pop-up message will confirm a successful staking attempt. You can find the staking history below where you can see options to claim rewards and unstake. However, these features require one team when you claim your rewards or unstake your BNB. Claiming your rewards will also require an ATP sent to the mobile number you use for sign-up to verify your claim. It's important to remember that your account takes 45 days to mature. Any unspeak BNB after 45 days will automatically restake within 24 hours.
